title: Engine readiness
help: 1 means ready; HTTP process liveness is different.

title: Process uptime
help: Process age, not an engine health guarantee.

title: Entered HTTP
help: All routes and body rejections; not admissions.

title: Admitted requests
help: Sequences that actually got an engine slot.

title: Engine completed
help: Successful engine completions; not TCP delivery.

title: Engine rejected
help: Engine refusals; HTTP validation refusals are in status counters.

title: Queue full
help: Engine queue/inbox admission refused.

title: Queue timeout
help: FIFO deadline expiration; not execution deadline.

title: Engine cancellations
help: Engine cancellation, including client departure or server stop-string cuts; not a server error.

title: FIFO queue depth
help: Post-step snapshot; may age during long prefill or idle.

title: Decoding slots
help: Post-step snapshot; not refreshed during a long prefill slice.

title: Prefilling slots
help: Post-step snapshot; slots used = decoding + prefilling.

title: Resolved slot capacity
help: Configured/resolved slots, not a guessed constant.

title: Reserved KV tokens
help: Admission reservations, NOT allocator memory. Post-step snapshot.

title: Planned KV capacity
help: Declared planned capacity; absent if engine cannot report it.

title: Admitted prompt rate
help: Full prompt including cached prefix; counter rate, NOT actual prefill or SSE.

title: Actual prefill progress rate
help: Successful backend slice token progress, including later cancelled requests; excludes cache restores.

title: Restored prompt rate
help: Cache-restored tokens; NOT backend prefill work.

title: Engine completion counter rate
help: Real engine token batch counter rate, NOT SSE chunks/s or client tok/s.

title: Engine token batches
help: Includes first batch; speculative batches can contain several tokens. NOT SSE.

title: HTTP to first engine batch p50 / p95
help: Includes body, preprocessing, inbox, FIFO and prefill. NOT client-flush TTFT.

title: Submit to first engine batch p50 / p95
help: Inbox + queue + prefill, excludes preprocessing. NOT SSE flush.

title: Engine batch gap p50 / p95
help: Between decoder-observed batches. NOT per-token latency or SSE cadence.

title: Server generation E2E p50 / p95
help: HTTP entry to terminal generation result, errors included; cancellations excluded. NOT network drain.

title: Preprocessing p50 / p95
help: HTTP body/template/tokenization/images until engine submit for submitted requests.

title: FIFO wait p50 / p95
help: Successful slot admission only; rejected queue timeouts excluded.

title: Prefilling engine step p50 / p95
help: Steps begun with prefills; may include concurrent decode. NOT whole-prefill latency.

title: HTTP headers by status
help: All routes, including 400/404/413; HTTP 200 does NOT mean SSE success.

title: SSE terminal outcomes
help: Success/error when terminal is body-polled; cancelled before terminal. NOT TCP acknowledgement.

title: Engine step errors
help: Real engine round errors.

title: Finished-request draft / accepted rates
help: Totals accumulated at request completion, not instantaneous in-flight draft rates.

title: Prefix cache hit rate
help: Absent when cache disabled; not an invented zero.

title: Engine gauge snapshot age
help: Can grow while idle; long age alone is NOT a stall.

title: Host MemAvailable (GB10 unified memory)
help: Real /proc/meminfo MemAvailable, NOT fabricated GPU VRAM free.

title: Host load average
help: Real /proc/loadavg; not GPU utilization.

title: GPU utilization
help: Bounded nvidia-smi polling outside engine/request path. Unsupported values are absent.

title: GPU temperature
help: Real nvidia-smi query; no simulated production samples.

title: GPU power
help: Real nvidia-smi; unsupported values absent, not zero.

title: Per-position acceptance / reached
help: Observed counter-delta ratio by mode / streams / position, not an in-flight prediction. Zero-sample windows remain empty.

title: Decode round phase counter rates
help: Engine wall seconds per phase by streams; post-step cumulative counters. NOT request latency.

title: Verify row counter rates
help: Actual verify rows by engine round stream count; not generated tokens or SSE.

title: Prefix cache evictions
help: Counter differences. Absent when cache disabled.

title: Admission reserved bytes
help: Admission reservations including pinned prefix cache; NOT CUDA allocator usage or GPU VRAM.

title: Admission byte capacity
help: Declared real engine admission budget, NOT host or GPU free memory.

title: GPU SM clock
help: Real nvidia-smi SM clock, outside engine/request paths; unavailable values absent.

title: GPU throttle reasons
help: Active NVML bitmask as decimal integer. Hardware slowdown8, thermal64 and power brake128 invalidate timing claims; software caps are distinct.
